dict.string: Keep your Mac awake with Amphetamine.

on alfred_script(q) my logLine("[on] invoked q=[" & (q as text) & "]") try set mins to my startSession(q) my logLine("[on] ok mins=" & mins) on error errMsg number errNum my reportError("[on]", errMsg, errNum) end try end alfred_script
on logLine(msg) try do shell script "mkdir -p \"$HOME/.local/state\"; printf '%s %s\n' \"$(date +%FT%T)\" " & quoted form of (msg as text) & " >> \"$HOME/.local/state/amphetamine-alfred.log\"" end try end logLine
on parseMinutes(q) set total to 0 set numbuf to "" set bareVals to {} set sawUnit to false repeat with i from 1 to (count of characters of q) set c to character i of q if c is in "0123456789" then set numbuf to numbuf & c else if c is "h" then if numbuf is not "" then set total to total + ((numbuf as integer) * 60) set numbuf to "" set sawUnit to true end if else if c is "m" then if numbuf is not "" then set total to total + (numbuf as integer) set numbuf to "" set sawUnit to true end if else if numbuf is not "" then set end of bareVals to (numbuf as integer) set numbuf to "" end if end if end repeat if numbuf is not "" then set end of bareVals to (numbuf as integer)
-- Two bare numbers with no unit letters means "hours minutes" (e.g. "1 30"). if sawUnit is false and (count of bareVals) is 2 then return (item 1 of bareVals) * 60 + (item 2 of bareVals) end if repeat with v in bareVals set total to total + (v as integer) end repeat return total end parseMinutes
on startSession(q) set mins to my parseMinutes(q as text) with timeout of 10 seconds tell application "Amphetamine" -- displaySleepAllowed is NOT optional: omitting it makes the handler -- fail with -10000, despite what Amphetamine.sdef implies. Carry the -- current preference through so the session matches the app's setting. set dsa to display sleep allowed if mins > 0 then start new session with options {duration:mins, interval:minutes, displaySleepAllowed:dsa} else start new session with options {duration:0, interval:0, displaySleepAllowed:dsa} end if end tell end timeout return mins end startSession
on reportError(label, errMsg, errNum) my logLine(label & " ERROR " & errNum & ": " & errMsg) display notification errMsg with title "Amphetamine workflow failed" subtitle ("AppleScript error " & errNum) end reportError

on alfred_script(q) my logLine("[off] invoked") try with timeout of 10 seconds tell application "Amphetamine" to end session end timeout my logLine("[off] ok") on error errMsg number errNum my reportError("[off]", errMsg, errNum) end try end alfred_script

Session, sleep settings, Triggers — ↩ toggles the session

Control Amphetamine from Alfred.
amphetamine on [duration] start a session (indefinite if no duration) amphetamine off end the current session amphetamine toggle [duration] end if active, otherwise start amphetamine status session, sleep settings, Triggers (↩ toggles) amphetamine help command reference + usage stats
Durations accept 30m, 2h, 1h 30m, 90 (minutes) or 1 30 (hours minutes).
Source of truth: ~/.dotfiles/config/AlfredApp/amphetamine (this directory is a symlink into it; run install.sh to relink). Every invocation is logged to ~/.local/state/amphetamine-alfred.log and failures raise a notification.
Originally 'Amphetamine Control' by William C. Gustafson (2016); rewritten for the Amphetamine 5.x AppleScript dictionary.
